General purpose expansion. WIP.

Currently adds:

5 Drills
3 Generators
9 Materials
4 Liquids
3 Special items

And a few more things.

Before you ask: Yes it IS V7-compatible.
V7-compatibility by gej302

Note: I am bad at balancing, so if you feel that something is imbalanced, please do tell me.
